Violations are treated as violations of the New Jersey Antitrust Act.","key_value":"Ban on algorithmic revenue management software or devices performing a coordinating function (shared nonpublic data / parallel pricing coordination) for residential rents; effective July 1, 2027","status":"not_yet_effective","effective_date":"2027-07-01","end_date":null,"citation":"P.L.2026, c.43","coverage_conditions":"Applies to all residential dwelling units in New Jersey (houses, apartments, accessory units or other units intended as a primary residence) and to any rental property owner, coordinator or other person. The following are excluded from 'coordinating function': research, statistical analysis or testing not used to set terms; free public rent estimates; equal-terms brokerage databases that do not set or recommend prices; and governments setting or limiting rents through affordability controls. Government entities are not coordinators. Parallel pricing required by affordability controls is not covered.
